title: Stainless Steel Cheese Grater Set, Set of 5 Kitchen Grater & Peeler & Slicer, Lemon Zester with Cleaning Brush for Vegetable, Fruit, Chocolate
description:
About this item
Set includes 2*Flat Grater & 1*Half Round Grater & 1*Lemon Grater & 1*Cleaning Brush. You'll be making beautiful meals in a fraction of the time. Enclosed brush making them super easy to clean. Of course, all of them are dishwasher safe.
These kitchen food graters are multi-purpose, the coarse shred grater is suitable for cheese, cabbage and other produce, the medium shred grater is suitable for vegetables like carrots and zucchini, and you can use the fine shred grater to make pulp, adding intense flavor to dishes.
Made of high quality durable stainless steel and use highly-polished processing method to bring the dual rust resistance protection of stainless steel. Do not worry about rust and deformation. The ergonomic stainless steel round handle with hole is comfortable. The hole make it easy to hang and storage.
